verses.1: Belshatsar Malka served as a great servant to our great leader. He received a thousand gifts in return.
verses.2: Belshatzar said, “In the name of Hamra, for the sake of the people of Dhaba and Kaspa. May they be freed from the prison in Jerusalem. May their king and ruler be blessed.”
verses.3: They came from the house of God in Jerusalem. Their wives were also from that house. They were kings and rulers over that land.
verses.4: May they be blessed and praised by the gods of Dhaba and Kaspa. May they be honored with gold and silver.
verses.5: At that time, a scroll was opened by human hands, and it was written on it that Nebreshta should be received upon the throne of the king. And the king saw the writing on it.
verses.6: Eadyn, king of the two nations, and my enemy, let them be terrified and ashamed. May their lives be destroyed by their own actions. This is what will happen to them.
verses.7: The king commanded his people to rise up and go to Ashpaya. Then, the scribes answered, “All people must write down this message clearly and accurately. May Argana rule over them.”
verses.8: Adin Alin is all those wise men who can write and understand the language of kings. They are not like those who can only read and understand it.
verses.9: Adin Malkah Belshatsar Shagiyah Mithvahal. Ziyuhi Shanayihi, my king and my great ruler, has risen from the dead.
verses.10: The queen wants to receive gifts from her king and her noble lord. She goes up to the house of Mishtaia. But the king says to her, “Do not be afraid, my daughter. Do not let your husband and children be separated.”
verses.11: May the spirit of the holy gods reign over your kingdom. In the days of your father, wisdom and knowledge were great. But now, your father has become a fool. He was a man of great wisdom, but now he has lost his wisdom. Your father created this kingdom.
verses.12: Everyone who receives the Spirit will be filled with wisdom and understanding. Our minds will become capable of dreaming and imagining things that are impossible to imagine. The darkness will be dispelled in this place called Beltsazar. Now, Daniele will be freed from its darkness, and everything will be clear.
verses.13: Bedarin Daniel was raised first. The king answered him and said, “You are indeed Daniel, one of the descendants of the Jews. My father was also a Jew.”
verses.14: And you will hear that a spirit of the gods is within you. And your wisdom will be revealed, and you will possess extraordinary knowledge.
verses.15: And just as my ancestors had written down these words, so too should we do the same. They were meant to be known and understood by us. They cannot be forgotten or neglected.
verses.16: And now, listen carefully! You must learn the rules of writing and reading. Only then can you truly understand me. May the words that I speak be written down, so that others can know me. And may they be used to govern you in your kingdom.
verses.17: Bediyn replied to Daniel and said, “First, king, you have given me your gifts. Your offerings and sacrifices will be given to others. I will call upon the king and ask for his help.”
verses.18: May the Lord, who is great and powerful, reign over you and bring prosperity to you. May His glory shine upon your descendants.
verses.19: And from the many things that Yehovah has done, all nations and tribes are created. They were created from His previous creations. The first creatures were those who were killed by Yehovah. Then there were those who were saved by Yehovah. And then there were those who were destroyed by Yehovah.
verses.20: And when her heart and her soul are filled with joy, then her throne will be adorned with precious decorations. Her treasures will be more valuable than anything else in the world.
verses.21: And from the children of Manashah, they will be disturbed and their hearts will be filled with sorrow. They will be destroyed by those who are powerful and cruel. Their names will be forgotten, and they will be destroyed completely. Only then will it be known that the great God has ruled over Manashah’s kingdom. And only then will he be able to establish his rule over them.
verses.22: And Antebrah Belshatsar does not deceive your heart. You know everything that happens, every decision you make.
verses.23: And upon Mar’e-Shamaya, there was destruction and ruin. May your enemies be destroyed, along with your ancestors, your wives, your children, and your livestock. May they be destroyed by fire. And may the gods of Kaspaf and Dahava be destroyed as well. May they be destroyed forever, without any hope or knowledge of what you have done. May those who worship you be destroyed in their own hands.
verses.24: From my ancestors, who were descendants of Pasa Dayya; and from those who wrote down their stories.
verses.25: And it is written that those who are wise will gradually become more and more intelligent.
verses.26: May God bless your reign and make it perfect.
verses.27: She was heard with her voice, and her sins were forgiven.
verses.28: May your kingdom be prosperous, and may it bring wisdom to those who seek it.
verses.29: Bediyin said, “Belshatsar and Hlibishu will go to Daniel Argana. They will also go to Menicha Di-Dahava. They will be crowned as rulers over their kingdom.”
verses.30: In those nights, the king was killed by Balashazar.
